correctness.rationale: For each partition, the local 0- and normalized one-excitation subspaces reduce |W_n> exactly to a q-party weighted W with coefficients sqrt(p_j), p_j=|B_j|/n. The explicit normalized block-product witness (|0_j>+alpha sqrt(p_j)|1_j>)/sqrt(1+alpha² p_j) has squared overlap alpha²/prod_j(1+alpha² p_j). Strict concavity of log(1+alpha²p) gives product <= (1+alpha²/q)^q, and alpha²=q/(q-1) yields F_Pi²>=((q-1)/q)^(q-1) strictly for nonuniform block sizes. For q|n the equal-block state is locally the symmetric q-qubit W, whose standard exact product overlap is A_q; singletons give A_n. Expanding (q-1)log(1-1/q) gives e^-1(1+1/(2q)+7/(24q²)+O(q^-3)). Bounds 2<=q<=n, q|n for equality; finite tests only corroborate.
